hero.body: We check what your child understands, help them explain it in their own words, and guide each step until they can apply it to a new problem.
hero.note: Start without entering a payment card.

report.body: Students and linked parents can review this week's change, difficult concepts, and the next recommended lesson.
cta.title: Make math click again today.

duet.title: Two companions help in two different ways.
duet.body: Chakchaki draws out the learner's thinking, while Gongsickyi checks the mathematical rule and evidence.
duet.chakchaki.role: Asks questions that help learners explain their thinking.
duet.gongsickyi.role: Checks formulas, calculations, and mathematical evidence.
